breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly retains the incorrect statement 'Apply the condition that pressure increases toward the center of curvature,' which is the exact error from the incomplete prompt. Although other lines in the specification (P_outer > P_inner being positive, dP/dn > 0 with n outward) contradict this and suggest the correct physics, the original erroneous claim was not removed or corrected. The agent repeated the user's incorrect instruction rather than fixing it to match the ground truth, which states pressure increases outward from the center of curvature.
